- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Fix the `TypeError` raised before the first training iteration when `--eval-interval` is not set, by treating an unset `eval_interval` as "no evaluation during training" when sizing validation data.

Since `core_v0.16.0`, `ValidationConfig.eval_interval` defaults to `None`. The training loop already handles that (`if cfg.validation.eval_interval and ...`), but two places still divided by it:

- `get_train_valid_test_num_samples()`: without `--full-validation` or `--skip-train`, it computed `train_iters // eval_interval + 1`. With an unset `eval_interval`, validation only runs once, after training, so this now uses a single eval point. With `--eval-iters 0` this yields 0 validation samples, so train-only setups work again.
- `build_train_valid_test_data_loaders()`: when resuming iteration-based training, it estimated `consumed_valid_samples` from `iteration // eval_interval`. With an unset `eval_interval` no validation runs during training, so the estimate is skipped and stays 0.

Behavior with `eval_interval` set is unchanged.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: Fixes #8625

## Code provenance

No code was copied or adapted from external sources.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
  - `tests/unit_tests/test_eval_batch_size.py`: sample counts with `eval_interval=None`, and with `eval_interval=None` plus `eval_iters=0` (the reproduction from the issue).
  - `tests/unit_tests/test_training.py`: resuming iteration-based training with `eval_interval=None` leaves `consumed_valid_samples` at 0.
- [x] I have added relevant functional tests (not needed: the change is limited to sample-count arithmetic covered by the unit tests)
- [x] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel ... (not applicable: no kernel changes)
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code (not applicable: no new functions or signatures)
- [x] I have added relevant documentation (not applicable: `ValidationConfig.eval_interval` already documents that evaluation does not run during training when it is unset)
- [x] I have run the autoformatter on my PR (black 26.3.0, isort 5.13.2, ruff and pylint 3.2.6 with the repository configuration on the changed test files)
